Discover the Situation

See how people use this English

Read the short phone call to a clinic.

Caller I'd like to make an appointment.
Receptionist Yes, of course.
Caller Is the doctor available tomorrow?
Receptionist Yes, in the morning or the afternoon.
Caller Can I come in the afternoon?
Receptionist Yes, that's fine.
Caller What time is the appointment?
Receptionist Three o'clock.
Caller What documents do I need?
Receptionist Your insurance card, please.
